export_evidence: No verifiable shipment row obtained. importkey.com/countries/india/hindustan-tyre-co and .../hindustan-tyre-company both returned only the paywalled template shell: "Shipments available for HINDUSTAN TYRE CO, refreshed daily" — a marketing placeholder, not a record. Rows actually seen: 0 (no date, no destination, no HS code, no B/L number). volza.com, eximpedia.app, trademo.com returned HTTP 403; importgenius.com returned a JavaScript challenge. No export record could be read, so no export shipment is asserted.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report split could be retrieved. DuckDuckGo search backend was unavailable during this run ("searx: Connection refused"), so no domestic-supply page was located. Rows actually seen: 0. GSTIN, turnover and contract data are not public in any source I could open — recorded as null, not estimated.
note: Name string is a merged cluster of at least two distinct legal entities — HINDUSTAN TYRE CO (proprietorship, per the 'PROP. HINDUSTAN CYCLES & TUBES PVT. LTD.' variant) and HINDUSTAN CYCLES AND TUBES PRIVATE LIMITED — plus spelling variants (HINDUSTHAN, TYERS). These must be split before any verdict; a single shipment status cannot legitimately cover both. Declared HS 401150 (new pneumatic tyres of rubber, bicycles) is consistent with the claimed bicycle-tyre line, but no customs line was read to confirm it. Per Rule 5: следов поставок не найдено в доступных источниках — this is an evidence-access failure, NOT proof of absence, and must not be written up as 'условно принят'. Both statuses are unknown, not none_found. Re-run required with a working search backend and a paid/free-trial customs view (ImportKey, Volza, Eximpedia) to obtain at least one dated B/L row and a GST turnover band.
